name: Marija Kovačić
bio:
Marija Kovačić didn't grow up around motorsport, but a chance encounter with a racing team during a security detail sparked an unexpected passion. Initially working private security, she quickly recognized vulnerabilities within motorsport event security and began developing innovative solutions. Her relentless pursuit of better protocols and her ability to anticipate potential threats caught the eye of Academy Motorsport, who brought her on to revamp their entire security apparatus.

Marija's approach is both proactive and collaborative. She believes in empowering her team, fostering a culture of vigilance, and constantly seeking out new technologies to enhance security measures. While others might focus solely on physical security, Marija understands the importance of cybersecurity and data protection, making her a truly modern security chief. She's known for her calm demeanor under pressure and her ability to think several steps ahead, making her an invaluable asset to the team.

What sets Marija apart is her blend of technical expertise and management skills. She isn't afraid to get her hands dirty, understanding the intricacies of the technology she employs. But more than that, she is a natural leader who inspires trust and loyalty in her team. Her focus is always on prevention, believing that a robust security plan is as crucial to success as a fast car.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair usually pulled back into a tight ponytail. She has a severe fringe cut above the eyebrows.
physical.description: Athletically built with a serious expression, Marija has a piercing gaze that commands attention.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with security protocols and risk assessments.
Has an uncanny ability to spot potential security flaws in seemingly innocuous situations.
Insists on a daily briefing on all potential threats, no matter how minor.
